title: Khudoo hidhrakum, "Take Precaution!" (Japan)
body:
Jumu`ah Suhbah
Yaa Rabbana! Yaa Rabbi 'ghfir wa 'rham Anta khayru 'r-raahimeen. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar,
Allahu Akbar, laa ilaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar,
laa ilaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'lAwwaleen wa ’l-akhireen, habeebi Rabbi 'l-`Alameen, Sayyidina Muhammadin wa aalihi wa saahbihi
ajma`een. Irham, yaa Rabbana! I 'ghfir lana wa 'rhamna. Tub `alayna wahdina wasqina wa ’slih shaanana wa
shaan al-Muslimeen. Yaa Rabbana! Khusoosan ahlu 'sh-Shaam, ahlu 'l-Misr, ahlu 'l-Libya, ahlu 'l-Yemen wa
daar al-Muslimeen, Turk, Kurd, Baghdad....wa 'l-`Arab. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders! Dastoor, yaa Rabbee! Nahnu `abeeduk (...). Allah Almighty created
Man weak, but the Children of Adam claim to be powerful ones. Man, in everything that they have been
granted, even in front of a virus. We are "winned" and yet feel our weakness in front of a virus, which is a
weak Creation. We know it exists but cannot see, touch, or hear it, and it is also glorifying (it's Creator).
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. We are running to Allah from Shaytan, and we are saying,
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Madad, yaa Sultan al-Awliya! Madad, yaa RijaalAllah! We know nothing.

Madad, yaa RijaalAllah. We are weak ones; we are tired. Only those supported with heavenly powers are
strong. If one of them (stomps his foot) on Earth, he may put our world out of orbit! But we are not asking for
such power; we must ask for the power to be obedient to our Creator, Allah Almighty, Who brought us into
existence and put us on this planet, for what? For thousands of years in this world, we have been sent on this
planet to live for a while. For what have we been sent? We do not know about that; are we not running to
understand? People are living and dying, being born and going away also, for what?
People claim they have reached the highest limit, but with what they have been granted, how did they reach
the top point and last limit? Like when driving there is a sign showing your speed has reached 100, no more;
similarly, now the Children of Adam have reached the last point, no more. When a person reaches a limit they
begin to come back (wane, decrease) until finishing. Now people living on Earth have reached the top point,
with no more capacity for Mankind to bring into existence that they may be trustful on that point, no. They
reached the last point and people are wondering what they are going to do now. A heavenly warning is
coming, "O People! Khudhoo hidhrakum." (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• ••••••• •••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••••• ••••••••
Yaa ayyuha ’Lladheena aamanoo khudhoo hidhrakum fa ’nfiroo thubaatin aw infiroo jamee`a. O you who
believe! Take your precautions, and either go forth in parties or go forth all together. (an-Nisa, 4:71)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Khudhoo hidhrakum, "Take precaution!" If you take one more step, you may fall
down and no one can take you up!
O People! Khudoo hidhrakum. You reached the last point, so don't take another step there or you will fall
down and never get up! Khudhoo hidhrakum! And people are not thinking on it, but they are looking at how
they should be standing up because now they fell down. All Mankind is falling down and asking to get up, and
the heavenly order is, "Don't move, you may fall down! That is a black hole. If you are going in it, there is no
way to come out." Khudhoo hidhrakum from heavenly black holes! Leave those black holes and come to
white holes filled with heavenly lights. You may enter it and it will spread, spread, spread, Huuuuuu,
endlessly. But those who are stepping in black holes will never get out, finished; they lost their chance that
was granted to them from their Creator, their Lord. Therefore, the warning is coming to people, "Don't step
one more step."

••••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••
•••••••••••
qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaymaanu wa
junooduhoo wa hum la yash`uroon. One of the ants said, "O ants! Enter your homes unless Sulayman and his
armies unknowingly trample you. (an-Naml, 27:18)
feehi khabaru ma qablakum wa nabaa ma ba`daakum, In it (Holy Qur'an) is news of what was before you and
informing you of what is after you. al-Qur'an `Azheem ash-sha'an! You can find everything in it, from
awwaleen wa ’l-aakhireen. You can't catch when it began, no, and no one knows where they are going in the
future. Khudhoo hidhrakum. Now people just reached a point from which they are astonishing, and they do
not know how they may save themselves or how they can step forward. The future is shown to them as a dark,
heavy blackness, but there is a heavenly potion (to counteract that): khudhoo hidhrakum, "Take care!" You
may lose your being in existence, you may lose your chance! You may reach that ocean that no one knows its
beginning or ending.
Now Mankind reached a limit where they are stopping and fearing.... SubhaanAllah! Perhaps the Japanese
people are the most advanced nation for technology, and yet a whip is coming on them! One whip came and
they became like drunk people. Now earthquakes are coming one after the other, for what? To make them
wake up! Heavy bombarding comes with volcanoes (note: Shinmoedake volcano recently erupted after 52
years of dormancy). If an order comes, I don't think (anyone can exist) throughout Japan; it will finish. That
needs only a volcano from Mt. Fuji; in ten minutes all will disappear! Therefore (the situation needs) some
potion, some responsible ones from among awliya, to reach Japan's people, an tu’minoo bi rabbikum, to
believe in your Lord!
It is possible that ocean now is like waves reaching to Japan's people, to make them wake up, and yet (they)
are not saying, "laa ilaha illa-Llah Muhammadan Rasoolullah." (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Khudhoo
hidhrakum! The most powerful protection for you is to say, "laa ilaha illa-Llah Muhammadan Rasoolullah;"
that is the meaning of khudhoo hidhrakum. It is a warning to Japan's people to say, "Leave falsehood and say
"laa ilaha illa-Llah," because that is going to protect you. If not it is impossible to take away (the destruction)!
Don't say this continent is fixed, like icebergs on fire or whole continents are on fire, swimming. With one

order that big continent (can be destroyed)! Japan is so small, but if an order comes, that tiny country will
sink in Fire Oceans!
Khudhoo hidhrakum. May Allah forgive us. I am tired. I am asking forgiveness from Allah Almighty and I am
warning all nations, first of all the Japanese people, who are not accepting any religion from Heavens, to
come to say, "Laa ilaha illa-Llah." (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Laa ilaha illa-Llah. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Allahuma thabitna `ala al-Haqq! Allahuma thabitna `ala al-Haqq! Allahuma thabitna `ala al-Haqq! Tawbah,
astaghfirullah.
That is a warning for the whole world! May Allah send us someone able to wake up nations, for the honor of
the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
Fatihah.
We hope by next week there will be more awakening among Mankind. May Allah forgive us, and bless you.
Fatihah.
